entities.name: Vietnamese Famine of 1945
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Vietnamese famine of 1944–45 was a famine that occurred in northern Vietnam in French Indochina during World War II from October 1944 to late 1945, which at the time was under Japanese occupation from 1940 with Vichy France as an ally of Nazi Germany in Western Europe. Between 400,000 and 2 million people are estimated to have starved to death during this time.
